name: @kerdial/platform-db
//exports: `./seed-data/instrument-catalogue` is a TEST-ONLY entry point. The 51-row instrument catalogue is not on `.`, so it is not loaded into the api or worker runtimes; the suites that need its row count reach it here. The subpath deliberately names the source file: `vitest.config.ts`'s alias derivation maps `<pkg>/<subpath>` to `<pkg>/src/<subpath>.ts`, so a shorter name would resolve under `tsc` and fail under Vitest. `.` is listed explicitly because declaring `exports` at all makes it the only gate on this package's entry points.
